metas.name: State of Play
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Inventing Anna

Journalists uncover a government conspiracy when a young politician's assistant and mistress is killed.

metas.name: The Twilight Zone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

Tales of science fiction, fantasy and the occult.

metas.name: Better Call Saul
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Breaking Bad

Albuquerque lawyer Jimmy McGill scrapes for clients and respect, but every win drags him closer to shady deals, dangerous players, and the alter ego Saul Goodman.

metas.name: Little Britain
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The League of Gentlemen

Matt Lucas and David Walliams, the creators of this character-comedy sketch show, delight in all that is mad, bad, quirky and generally bonkers about the people and places of Britain.

metas.name: Will & Grace
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

Gay lawyer Will and straight interior designer Grace share a New York City apartment. Their best friends are gleeful and proud gay Jack and charismatic, filthy-rich, amoral socialite Karen.

metas.name: The Andy Warhol Diaries
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Billy Connolly: Made in Scotland

After he's shot in 1968, Andy Warhol begins documenting his life and feelings. Those diaries, and this docuseries, take a peek behind his persona.

metas.name: Castle Rock
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Widow's Bay

A psychological-horror series set in the Stephen King multiverse combines the mythological scale and intimate character storytelling, weaving an epic saga of darkness and light, played out on a few square miles of Maine woodland.

metas.name: Santa Clarita Diet
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Human Remains

Sheila and Joel are married real estate agents who live and work in Santa Clarita, California. When Sheila dies, their lives take a dark turn.

metas.name: Criminal Record
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Inventing Anna

Follows two brilliant detectives in a tug of war over a historic murder conviction and the quest to find common ground in a polarized Britain.

metas.name: Night Visions
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

"Night Visions" was a hosted anthology series similar to "The Twilight Zone" - some tales are supernatural, others are just commentaries on twisted human nature. Each hour show is made up of two half-hour stories aired back-to-back.

metas.name: Narcos: Mexico
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Breaking Bad

The rise of the Guadalajara Cartel as an American DEA agent learns the danger of targeting narcos in Mexico.

metas.name: French and Saunders
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The League of Gentlemen

Comedy duo Dawn French and Jennifer Saunders satirically present aspects of British life, films such as Batman Forever and Pulp Fiction.

metas.name: Don't Trust the B---- in Apartment 23
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

A naive young woman finds herself with a wild roommate when she moves to New York.

metas.name: The Zen Diaries of Garry Shandling
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Billy Connolly: Made in Scotland

The story of legendary comedian Garry Shandling, featuring interviews from nearly four dozen friends, family and colleagues; four decades’ worth of television appearances; and a lifetime of personal journals, private letters and home audio and video footage.

metas.name: Fear Itself
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Widow's Bay

A television series broken down into 13 separate 60-minute films from premiere horror writers and directors.

metas.name: The Fall and Rise of Reginald Perrin
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Human Remains

This story concerns a middle-aged middle manager, Reginald "Reggie" Perrin, who is driven to bizarre behaviour by the pointlessness of his job at Sunshine Desserts.

metas.name: The Girlfriend Experience
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Inventing Anna

Explores the relationships between exclusive escorts and their clients, for whom they provide far more than just sex. Known as GFEs, they are women who provide emotional and sexual relationships at a very high price.

metas.name: Doctor Who
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

The adventures in time and space of the Doctor, a Time Lord who changes appearance and personality by regenerating when near death, and is joined by companions in battles against aliens and other megalomaniacs.

metas.name: Snowfall
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Breaking Bad

A look at the early days of the crack cocaine epidemic in Los Angeles during the beginning of the 1980s.

metas.name: A Bit of Fry and Laurie
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The League of Gentlemen

Comedians Stephen Fry and Hugh Laurie perform a variety of comedy skits and the occasional musical number.

metas.name: What I Like About You
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

When Holly's father is transferred to Japan, she is sent to live with her big sister Valerie in New York City, turning Valerie's life upside down.

metas.name: Mind Field
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Billy Connolly: Made in Scotland

Join me on a journey into the mysterious depths of the human psyche as I investigate the strange and surprising terrain of the Mind Field.

metas.name: The Addams Family
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Human Remains

The misadventures of a blissfully macabre but extremely loving family.

metas.name: Good Girls
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Inventing Anna

Three suburban mothers suddenly find themselves in desperate circumstances and decide to stop playing it safe and risk everything to take back their power.

metas.name: The Langoliers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

Most of the passengers on an airplane disappear, and the remainder land the plane in a mysteriously barren airport.

metas.name: Narcos
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Breaking Bad

A chronicled look at the criminal exploits of Colombian drug lord Pablo Escobar, as well as the many other drug kingpins who plagued the country through the years.

metas.name: The New Statesman
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The League of Gentlemen

The ultra right-wing Alan B'Stard, the most selfish, greedy, dishonest, sadistic and sociopathic Conservative MP of them all, plots to achieve his meglomaniacal ambitions.

metas.name: The Jeffersons
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

Wealthy African American dry cleaner George Jefferson, his wife Louise, and son Lionel move into a luxury apartment building and develop occasionally fractious relations with other tenants, including their sassy maid Florence.

metas.name: Eli Roth's History of Horror
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Billy Connolly: Made in Scotland

An in-depth look at the history and pop cultural significance of horror films.

metas.name: Chapelwaite
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Widow's Bay

Captain Charles Boone relocates his family of three children to his ancestral home in Maine after his wife dies at sea.

metas.name: Bad Thoughts
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Human Remains

Showcases a series of vignettes where the stories unfold in a hilariously disturbing way.

metas.name: Suits
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Inventing Anna

On the run from a drug deal gone bad, brilliant college dropout Mike Ross finds himself working with Harvey Specter, one of New York City's best lawyers.

metas.name: Seven Days
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

An ex-CIA is the point man for a government organization dedicated to time traveling to correct errors that occurred in the previous week.

metas.name: Dark Winds
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Breaking Bad

Follows Leaphorn and Chee, two Navajo police officers in the 1970s Southwest that are forced to challenge their own spiritual beliefs when they search for clues in a double murder case.

metas.name: Big Train
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The League of Gentlemen

A British sketch comedy show where people in ordinary situations suddenly find themselves in absurd situations.

metas.name: The Exes
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

A group of divorced friends tries to get back to the single life.

metas.name: The Beatles Anthology
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Billy Connolly: Made in Scotland

The Beatles candidly tell their own story, with all its complexities and contradictions.

metas.name: Shining Vale
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Widow's Bay

A family moves to a small town into a house in which terrible atrocities have taken place. But nobody seems to notice except for Pat, who's convinced she's either depressed or possessed--turns out, the symptoms are exactly the same.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Human Remains

Level-headed son Michael Bluth takes over family affairs after his father is imprisoned. But the rest of his spoiled, dysfunctional family are making his job unbearable.

metas.name: Goliath
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Inventing Anna

A disgraced lawyer, now an ambulance chaser, gets a case that could bring him redemption or at least revenge on the firm that expelled him.

metas.name: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

A group of teenagers meet in the woods, and tell scary stories.

metas.name: Animal Kingdom
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Breaking Bad

Centers on a Southern California family, whose excessive lifestyle is fueled by their criminal activities.

metas.name: SCTV
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The League of Gentlemen

The staff of Melonville's TV station put on programming that is unique in its own silly way.

metas.name: The King of Queens
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

Deliveryman Doug Heffernan has a good life: He has a pretty wife (Carrie), a big television, and friends with which to watch it. Then Carrie's goofy, annoying father Arthur moves in with them.

metas.name: Hot Girls Wanted: Turned On
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Billy Connolly: Made in Scotland

Personal stories reveal how the intersection of sex, technology and intimate relationships is rewiring us in fundamental ways.

metas.name: Wrecked
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Widow's Bay

When a plane crashes on a deserted island on the way to Thailand, the crash survivors struggle to get along, and heads clash as they have differing views on how to stay alive and get off the island.

metas.name: Married... with Children
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Human Remains

Al is the quintessential working class dad. Peggy, his wife, always wants more from him. With their children, they go through the highs and lows of ordinary life.

metas.name: Bosch: Legacy
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Inventing Anna

Bosch embarks on the next chapter of his career and finds himself working with his one-time enemy, Honey Chandler.

metas.name: Doctor Who
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

Continuing on from Doctor Who (1963), this revival follows the further adventures of the Doctor and their companions as they encounter various alien threats and save civilizations on different planets and time periods.

metas.name: Queen of the South
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Breaking Bad

Teresa flees Mexico after her drug-runner boyfriend is murdered. Settling in Dallas she looks to become the country's reigning drug smuggler and to avenge her lover's murder.

metas.name: Spitting Image
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The League of Gentlemen

A satire show using puppets that are caricatures of major public figures.

metas.name: Gimme Gimme Gimme
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

Raucous 90s sitcom starring Kathy Burke and James Dreyfus as awful flatmates. Tom is an out-of-work actor with a sharp tongue, and Linda La Hughes is his dysfunctional friend.

metas.name: Pretty Baby: Brooke Shields
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Billy Connolly: Made in Scotland

Follows actor, model, and icon Brooke Shields as she becomes a woman who discovers her power after being a sexualized young girl. She shows the dangers and triumphs of gaining agency in a hostile world.

metas.name: Desperate Housewives
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Widow's Bay

A close-knit group of housewives reside in Wisteria Lane. It may appear to be a seemingly perfect neighborhood but it hides many secrets, crimes, forbidden romances and domestic struggles.

metas.name: A Black Lady Sketch Show
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Human Remains

A half-hour sketch comedy written by and starring Robin Thede.

metas.name: Devious Maids
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched Inventing Anna

Four Latina maids with their own ambitions and dreams work for the rich and famous of Beverly Hills.

metas.name: Star Trek
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Twilight Zone

In the 23rd Century, Captain James T. Kirk and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise explore the galaxy and defend the United Federation of Planets.

metas.name: Mr Inbetween
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Breaking Bad

Ray Shoesmith is a father, ex-husband, boyfriend, brother and best friend; tough roles to juggle in the modern age. Especially, when you're also a criminal for hire.

metas.name: Key and Peele
metas.description:
🎯 Because you watched The League of Gentlemen

In front of a live studio audience, Keegan-Michael Key and Jordan Peele banter about a topic woven between filmed shorts and sketches.

metas.name: Game-On
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Friends

The misadventures of three twenty-something flatmates, bound together by circumstance. Mandy is sexually active, Martin is sexually inactive, and their troubled landlord Matthew never leaves the flat.
